page.overview:
Who is Amali?

At night, can encounter by the in the 's. She asks him who he usually for. If says he cooks for himself, hopes she did not ask too personal of a question. When she cooks, wonders about the future of the village and her family. Her thoughts are dark, but they are lighter once she eats. She encourages him to use the.

After has been appeased, is still on the platform, this time calling for. She turns to and says that she cannot find anywhere and wonders where she could be. Amali considers the possibility that she could have gone to to practice her singing. However, it is far away and worries whether she could have made it there on her own. This initiates the "."

Once has been found, is relieved that she is at after all. She gives 50 as thanks for letting her know. feels much better now that she knows where is and thanks again. It sets her mind at ease to know where her children are. Her daughters are gathering the ingredients necessary to make, since will not sing with her sisters until she has some. She hopes they stay safe as they are all out gathering ingredients.

When 's daughters finish their recital at, they return to her in this story. She can be found in the, where she hopes her children are not causing too much grief. Upon 's return to, is inside her home and thanks for bringing her husband back.
